sources.observation: A scalloped gray dome shelters a ring of open classical columns with staghorn fern capitals, above broad circular steps.
The main observatory has pale classical trim, narrow arched openings and a pierced parapet. The adjacent Astrograph House has a square base and silver dome.

sources.credit: Shkuru Afshar / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
sources.observation: A low timber link joins the two round cream observatory houses. The lower room has a silver dome and the higher room a shallow conical roof.

limitations: The model covers the Temple of the Winds and the modeled observatory buildings near the west entrance. The native map supplies the rest of the Melbourne Gardens, including its water, paths, planting and other buildings. Exterior heights, capital foliage and fine mouldings are photographic estimates.
